og:title: ElevenLabs MCP in Claude: Create and manage ElevenLabs voice agents in your chat | Product Hunt
og:description: Connect Claude to your ElevenLabs workspace to create and manage voice agents. Find existing agents, review their configuration, update prompts and voices, duplicate or delete agents.

title: envfix: A tiny .env doctor for Node.js projects | Product Hunt
og:title: envfix: A tiny .env doctor for Node.js projects | Product Hunt
og:description: envfix is a zero-dependency CLI for diagnosing and fixing environment configuration problems. It detects missing, empty, extra, and duplicate variables, catches malformed declarations, checks Git safety, generates and syncs example environment files, and works locally or in CI. Run it instantly with npx envfix.

title: Epho: Run Claude Code, Codex or Opencode in cloud with your repo | Product Hunt
og:title: Epho: Run Claude Code, Codex or Opencode in cloud with your repo | Product Hunt
og:description: Epho runs claude code, codex, or opencode in the cloud. POST a message, stream back the work. no sdk, no daemon, no infra on your side. Epho manages the underlying sandboxes, fallbacks, event streaming, and agent configuration for you. With a single API call, you can easily launch a Claude Code session that is already connected to your repo, understands your context, and runs in a serverless sandbox.

title: HarnessRouter: World's first unified agent harness interface. Open source | Product Hunt
og:title: HarnessRouter: World's first unified agent harness interface. Open source | Product Hunt
og:description: HarnessRouter is an open-source unified interface that lets product teams plug Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, and other supported agent harnesses into their products through one Agent API. It enables them to build and scale agent-powered products quickly without managing separate agent backends.

title: Equitybee: Get the funding you need to exercise your stock options | Product Hunt
og:title: Equitybee: Get the funding you need to exercise your stock options | Product Hunt
og:description: Equitybee enables startup employees own their equity by providing capital to exercise their stock options. They become shareholders and benefit from the value they’ve created while working at the company, in return for a share in their potential future gains.

title: EssayKraft: Native essay writing app for Mac and iPad | Product Hunt
og:title: EssayKraft: Native essay writing app for Mac and iPad  | Product Hunt
og:description: EssayKraft is a native Swift Mac and iPad writing app built for students who are tired of wrestling with reference managers. Write essays, papers and dissertations with a built-in reference manager, automatic citations, rich text formatting and PDF or DOCX export, all in one place. No subscriptions, no accounts, no juggling citation tools. Just a fast, distraction-free writing experience designed specifically for academic work. Buy once, own it forever.

title: Evidence: Business intelligence as code | Product Hunt
og:title: Evidence: Business intelligence as code | Product Hunt
og:description: Evidence is a code-based business intelligence tool. It's the best way to build live dashboards and reports with coding agents.

title: Expeditione: The Interactive 3D Encyclopedia | Product Hunt
og:title: Expeditione: The Interactive 3D Encyclopedia | Product Hunt
og:description: Created by a single person, Expeditione is an Interactive 3D Encyclopedia built to make learning fun and memorable. Instead of simply reading about a subject, you can enter handcrafted, explorable worlds and discover them through interaction. It runs directly in the browser, with no login, ads, or tracking, and is optimized to stay remarkably lightweight. The first three expeditions are free forever, with free educator resources for classroom use.

title: E.Y.E. by Expert Chase: Where human life runs with AI | Product Hunt
og:title: E.Y.E. by Expert Chase: Where human life runs with AI | Product Hunt
og:description: We're on a mission to make AI actually useful in real life. We help people organize every aspect of their everyday life in one place with our AI, E.Y.E. It draws on users’ real-life data and answers based on that data, not generic responses. We’re here to replace all to-do apps, calendar apps, food trackers, sleep trackers, habit trackers, finance trackers, fitness trackers, notes, everything. One subscription. Unlimited AI. Plus Integrations. btw EYE stands for “Empower Your Everyday”.

title: Expertise AI: The fastest way to build, run, share & own AI agents. | Product Hunt
og:title: Expertise AI: The fastest way to build, run, share & own AI agents. | Product Hunt
og:description: Expertise is a platform to build, run, share, and own AI skills. Experts publish their playbooks as protected, monetizable skills on a page of their own. Businesses install them in one click or build their own, spreading how their best people use AI across every seat in the company.

title: Firecrawl: The Web Data API for AI Agents and Developers | Product Hunt
og:title: Firecrawl: The Web Data API for AI Agents and Developers | Product Hunt
og:description: The API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale.

title: Fairphone: The world's most repairable phone | Product Hunt
og:title: Fairphone: The world's most repairable phone | Product Hunt
og:description: Fairphone is a social enterprise that is building a movement for fairer electronics. By making a phone, we’re opening up the supply chain and creating new relationships between people and their products.

title: FetchSandbox: API integration testing that remembers what breaks | Product Hunt
og:title: FetchSandbox: API integration testing that remembers what breaks | Product Hunt
og:description: Most API tests stop at 200 OK. FetchSandbox lets developers and AI agents verify what happens next—webhooks, retries, state changes, async workflows, and failure scenarios. It reproduces the real bug, proves the fix, and remembers what breaks—so your agent catches it before production. Connect via MCP to Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, and Codex. Explore 60+ APIs—Stripe, GitHub, Clerk, Resend, Twilio, Descope, OpenAI—without burning real API quota or waiting on staging.

title: Fiamo: One tiny real-life quest a day. Then it tells you to leave. | Product Hunt
og:title: Fiamo: One tiny real-life quest a day. Then it tells you to leave. | Product Hunt
og:description: Fiamo gives everyone on Earth the same tiny real-life quest each day - like giving a stranger an honest compliment, or eating one meal without your phone. Mark it done, watch a live counter of everyone doing today's quest with you, then Fiamo tells you to close the app and go live your life. No feed, no login, nothing to scroll. Just one small nudge back into the real world, every day, for free.

title: FileFlippers: Send big files and get paid on download | Product Hunt
og:title: FileFlippers: Send big files and get paid on download | Product Hunt
og:description: FileFlippers is file delivery built for freelancers and studios who are tired of clunky transfers and chasing invoices. Send large files with fast, resumable uploads on your own branded pages. Add watermarks, collect client feedback, and keep versions tidy. Then gate the final files behind payment, so the download unlocks the moment you get paid. AI enhance and convert are built in too, so you can upscale or reformat without leaving the tab. Fast, secure, and branded. Free plan available.

title: FileRouter: Take control of files and editors | Product Hunt
og:title: FileRouter: Take control of files and editors | Product Hunt
og:description: A default handler for multiple file types that opens the right editor — Velja/Choosy for files. Full control of any file type and what editor(s) open it, with radial picker and custom rules.

title: Finamie: Speak your expenses and get instant spending insights | Product Hunt
og:title: Finamie: Speak your expenses and get instant spending insights | Product Hunt
og:description: Finamie turns your voice into detailed financial insights, automatically. Log expenses hands-free, track your spending, and understand your money like never before.

title: Finch: A single place for your health data and tests | Product Hunt
og:title: Finch: A single place for your health data and tests | Product Hunt
og:description: Finch is a patient-side health companion built for all — an expecting parent, or just someone navigating the health system. Pregnancy alone involves at least 12 appointments, dozens of test results, and a new vocabulary, coming from different providers in different formats. That's just one example. Whatever your journey, Finch brings it into one clear view, transcribes what was said at your appointments, and translates clinical language into plain English. Free tier available. Finch+ $99/y

title: Finyuus: A code-first language for durable, governed AI workflows | Product Hunt
og:title: Finyuus: A code-first language for durable, governed AI workflows | Product Hunt
og:description: ConFinyuus is a code-first platform for building, running, and governing AI workflows. It introduces a small indentation-based DSL for composing agents, tools, guards, human approvals, and nested workflows — then runs them on Temporal with retries, cancellation, and replayability. Unlike visual builders, workflows are stored as text for Git-based review and diffs. Unlike prompt chains, every run is durable, versioned, observable via Langfuse, and governable through guards and human approvals.

title: Flare: The graph-first IDE and interactive map for agentic coding | Product Hunt
og:title: Flare: The graph-first IDE and interactive map for agentic coding | Product Hunt
og:description: Most agentic coding tools hand you a chat log. Flare hands you the map. Every file is a node, every import an edge, with a real terminal underneath where you run claude, codex or opencode. The graph updates live as the agent edits, attributes every write to whoever made it, and pulls you in when it rewrites something the rest of the app imports. Change bursts snapshot to local history you can diff and revert. Agents take work from a board over MCP. Your machine. No account. MIT licensed.

title: Flown: Every flight you've ever taken, on one private map | Product Hunt
og:title: Flown: Every flight you've ever taken, on one private map | Product Hunt
og:description: Every flight you've ever taken, drawn on one map. Tick off 197 countries, collect passport stamps, see your year in the air. And when a late flight means the airline owes you £220-£520, Flown works it out and tells you. On-device, no account.

title: FluidDocs: Interactive HTML docs that answer questions and report back | Product Hunt
og:title: FluidDocs: Interactive HTML docs that answer questions and report back | Product Hunt
og:description: FluidDocs are interactive HTML documents that keep working after you hit send. A proposal that reprices itself, an offer with live equity math, an API reference that rewrites its examples around the reader's key. Every document answers questions from its own content, and reader analytics come out of the box. The open source Deck Builder that launched here lives on as part of the platform, and the template gallery at fluiddocs.ai/templates is the fastest way in.

title: Flunkey: Voice-first AI layer for Windows (beta) | Product Hunt
og:title: Flunkey: Voice-first AI layer for Windows (beta) | Product Hunt
og:description: Flunkey is a voice-first productivity tool for Windows that turns spoken thoughts into text, useful actions, and remembered context wherever you work. It is similar to Wispr Flow but has an AI feature which you can use to easily ask questions. It is really productive for students, researchers, and people who use a lot of context and is a general-purpose tool that you can use for your day-to-day lives.

title: Freebuff: Free coding agents to kill Claude, Cursor, Replit, and Devin | Product Hunt
og:title: Freebuff: Free coding agents to kill Claude, Cursor, Replit, and Devin | Product Hunt
og:description: Freebuff is a free coding agent that gives you access to the best open source models. We offer a CLI, Desktop app, Web app builder, and Cloud agent -- all free! This is the free way to build full-stack apps. No subscription, no API keys, no lock-in. Cancel your subscriptions to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Lovable, Replit, Bolt, Windsurf, and Devin.

title: FreqWave EQ: Customize your web audio with a real-time EQ | Product Hunt
og:title: FreqWave EQ: Customize your web audio with a real-time EQ | Product Hunt
og:description: 8-band Web Audio Equalizer - fixing muddy podcasts, harsh streams and quiet dialogue. Featuring EQ modes and DSP Compression.

title: fx (by Vercel): Vercel's tiny, open-source coding agent | Product Hunt
og:title: fx (by Vercel): Vercel's tiny, open-source coding agent | Product Hunt
og:description: fx is Vercel's tiny, open-source coding agent built to get out of your way. Written in Zig and shipped as a ~6MB native binary, it starts almost instantly while keeping memory and context overhead low. Use it with local or cloud models, extend it with skills, plugins and MCPs, or embed it into your own agent infrastructure. Small by design, so the model gets more room to work.

title: Gauge: Agent-led Growth: Get written into every customer's codebase | Product Hunt
og:title: Gauge: Agent-led Growth: Get written into every customer's codebase | Product Hunt
og:description:
Agents are leading the next wave of growth for companies like Supabase, Openrouter, Resend, PostHog, Braintrust, and more.

Unlike chat experiences, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor are now implementing products autonomously. They are doing so without ever talking to a sales rep or taking a demo.

Gauge runs real coding sessions across the top harnesses to identify actions to improve the agent’s preference for your tool, and the agent experience once you’re selected.

title: Mozilla отзывает GPG-ключ подписи для Firefox и Thunderbird: он случайно попал на GitHub — Хакер
og:title: Mozilla отзывает GPG-ключ подписи для Firefox и Thunderbird: он случайно попал на GitHub
og:description: Разработчики Mozilla были вынуждены сменить GPG-ключ, которым подписывают некоторые релизы Firefox и Thunderbird для Linux. Дело в том, что незашифрованная копия этого ключа по ошибке попала в приватный репозиторий на GitHub. Хотя не было обнаружено никаких признаков того, что ключ мог попасть в руки посторонних, разработчики приняли решение отозвать его на всякий случай.

title: Microsoft перенесла выход новой версии Exchange из-за уязвимостей, которые находит ИИ — Хакер
og:title: Microsoft перенесла выход новой версии Exchange из-за уязвимостей, которые находит ИИ
og:description: Представители Microsoft объяснили, почему первое крупное накопительное обновление для Exchange Server Subscription Edition (SE) до сих пор не вышло, хотя было запланировано на первую половину 2026 года. Одной из причин задержки стали ИИ-инструменты, которые помогают специалистам компании искать уязвимости: найденных багов стало так много, что команда Exchange тратит почти все время на их проверку, исправление и выпуск ежемесячных патчей.
